component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.appTask = createObject("roSGNode", "AppTask") m.appTask.observeField("ready", "onAppTaskReady") m.appTask.control = "run" end sub
sub onAppTaskReady(event as object) if event.getData() then m.top.agentReady = true end sub
' Matches the reported crash's call shape exactly: callFunc issued from the render (main) ' thread's own clean loop context (source/main.brs), onto a node handle read back from ' m.global -- the agent Node was constructed by AppTask (a Task), not by render. function doHarvestCall() as Dynamic agent = m.global.nrAgent result = agent.callFunc("setHarvestTime", 42) print "SCENE: callFunc returned " + result.toStr() m.top.done = true return result end function
